audit_role: independent execution/protocol/source/usage auditor; no quality evaluation
limitations: No final-answer quality, citation validity, or retrieval usefulness was assessed. Judge, blind-answer, mapping and review files were not accessed.
Only this completed task was inspected; no polling or claim about the other task is made.
Final answers were compared programmatically for equality/hash and nonempty delivery, without emitting or grading their prose.
Successful MCP means an admitted call had a matching non-error tool_result; useful evidence or causal benefit requires separate review.
Source export inventory was independently recomputed; post-trial source unchanged is retained controller evidence, since the destroyed runner filesystem cannot be inspected.
Native binary/cache bytes and private runtime configuration are excluded from artifact; identity is supported by frozen code, provenance, commands, startup and preflight evidence.
Live provider request bodies were not archived. 8192 is the recorded per-request configuration; final output token usage is session-cumulative.
Secret scans cover known injected credentials; passing reports and empty findings are checked without possessing the secret values.
Recorded hook and agent timings are not an independent external clock.
All outcomes are retained; no rerun, replacement, quality conclusion, statistical claim or q001 pooling occurred.
